# Samsung Canada
> Samsung Canada offers consumer electronics, mobile devices, TVs, home appliances, support resources, and online shopping.

Samsung Canada provides product information, purchasing, support, account services, and business solutions across mobile, TV and audio, computing, appliances, and accessories. The site also links to Samsung's developer, newsroom, and business platforms.

## Shop
- [Samsung Canada Home](https://www.samsung.com/ca/): Main entry for Samsung Canada products, offers, and category navigation.
- [Cart](https://shop.samsung.com/ca/cart): Shopping cart for Samsung Canada online purchases.
- [Smartphones](https://www.samsung.com/ca/smartphones/): Browse Galaxy smartphones, features, and purchase options.
- [Tablets](https://www.samsung.com/ca/tablets/): Explore Galaxy tablets for entertainment, work, and study.
- [Watches](https://www.samsung.com/ca/watches/): Discover Galaxy smartwatches and wearable features.
- [Buds](https://www.samsung.com/ca/buds/): View Galaxy Buds wireless earbuds and audio accessories.
- [Accessories](https://www.samsung.com/ca/mobile-accessories/): Shop mobile accessories including cases, chargers, and wearables add-ons.

## TV and Audio
- [TVs](https://www.samsung.com/ca/tvs/): Explore Samsung TVs across OLED, QLED, and lifestyle ranges.
- [Sound Devices](https://www.samsung.com/ca/audio-devices/): Browse soundbars, speakers, and home audio products.
- [Projectors](https://www.samsung.com/ca/projectors/): Discover Samsung projectors for home entertainment and presentations.
- [TV Accessories](https://www.samsung.com/ca/tv-accessories/): Find mounts, remotes, and accessories for Samsung TVs.
- [Lifestyle TVs](https://www.samsung.com/ca/lifestyle-tvs/): Learn about design-focused TVs including The Frame and related models.

## Home Appliances
- [Home Appliances](https://www.samsung.com/ca/home-appliances/): Overview of Samsung appliances for kitchen, laundry, and home care.
- [Refrigerators](https://www.samsung.com/ca/refrigerators/): Browse Samsung refrigerators with smart and family-focused features.
- [Laundry](https://www.samsung.com/ca/washers-and-dryers/): Explore washers, dryers, and laundry solutions.
- [Cooking Appliances](https://www.samsung.com/ca/cooking-appliances/): View ranges, microwaves, and other kitchen cooking products.
- [Dishwashers](https://www.samsung.com/ca/dishwashers/): Find Samsung dishwashers for different kitchen configurations.
- [Vacuums](https://www.samsung.com/ca/vacuum-cleaners/): Discover cordless and robot vacuum cleaners.

## Computing and Displays
- [Laptops](https://www.samsung.com/ca/computers/): Explore Galaxy Book laptops and portable computing devices.
- [Monitors](https://www.samsung.com/ca/monitors/): Browse gaming, smart, and professional monitors.
- [Memory and Storage](https://www.samsung.com/ca/memory-storage/): View SSDs, memory cards, and storage products.
- [Displays](https://www.samsung.com/ca/displays/): Learn about consumer and commercial display offerings.

## Support
- [Support Home](https://www.samsung.com/ca/support/): Central hub for product help, manuals, repairs, and troubleshooting.
- [Contact Us](https://www.samsung.com/ca/support/contact/): Reach Samsung support through available contact channels.
- [Manuals and Software](https://www.samsung.com/ca/support/downloads/): Download product manuals, drivers, and software updates.
- [Warranty](https://www.samsung.com/ca/support/warranty/): Review warranty information and coverage details.
- [Repair Service](https://www.samsung.com/ca/support/repair/): Start repair requests and service-related support tasks.
- [Product Registration](https://www.samsung.com/ca/support/register-product/): Register Samsung products for support and ownership records.

## Account and Services
- [Samsung Account](https://account.samsung.com/): Sign in and manage Samsung account settings and services.
- [Samsung Members](https://www.samsung.com/ca/apps/samsung-members/): Learn about the Samsung Members community and support app.
- [SmartThings](https://www.samsung.com/ca/smartthings/): Explore Samsung's smart home platform and connected device ecosystem.
- [Samsung Health](https://www.samsung.com/ca/apps/samsung-health/): Overview of Samsung Health fitness and wellness features.
- [Samsung Wallet](https://www.samsung.com/ca/apps/samsung-wallet/): Learn about Samsung Wallet payments, passes, and digital storage.
- [Samsung Knox](https://www.samsung.com/ca/knox/): Discover Samsung security and device protection capabilities.

## Offers and Programs
- [Offers](https://www.samsung.com/ca/offer/): Browse current Samsung Canada promotions and special deals.
- [Trade-In](https://www.samsung.com/ca/trade-in/): Learn about device trade-in options and eligibility.
- [Samsung Care+](https://www.samsung.com/ca/offer/samsung-care-plus/): Review device protection plans and coverage options.
- [Student Offers](https://www.samsung.com/ca/offer/student-and-educator-discounts/): Access education discounts for eligible students and educators.
- [Employee Offers Program](https://www.samsung.com/ca/offer/employee-discount-program/): Information about workplace discount eligibility and benefits.
- [First Responders Offers](https://www.samsung.com/ca/offer/first-responders-discounts/): Discount program details for eligible first responders.

## Business
- [Samsung Business Canada](https://www.samsung.com/ca/business/): Business-focused products, solutions, and enterprise support resources.
- [Business Displays](https://www.samsung.com/ca/business/displays/): Commercial display solutions for signage, hospitality, and workplaces.
- [Business Mobile](https://www.samsung.com/ca/business/mobile/): Enterprise mobile devices and mobility solutions.
- [Business Computing](https://www.samsung.com/ca/business/computing/): Laptops, monitors, and workplace computing products for organizations.
- [Business Support](https://www.samsung.com/ca/business/support/): Support resources tailored for Samsung business customers.
- [Samsung Knox for Business](https://www.samsung.com/ca/business/knox/): Enterprise security and device management platform information.

## News and Corporate
- [Samsung Newsroom Canada](https://news.samsung.com/ca/): Official Samsung Canada news, announcements, and stories.
- [About Samsung](https://www.samsung.com/ca/about-us/): Corporate overview, values, and company information.
- [Sustainability](https://www.samsung.com/ca/sustainability/): Learn about Samsung sustainability goals and initiatives.
- [Careers](https://www.samsung.com/ca/about-us/careers/): Explore career opportunities and employment information.
- [Investor Relations](https://www.samsung.com/global/ir/): Access Samsung global investor relations resources and updates.

## Developer and Technical Resources
- [Samsung Developers](https://developer.samsung.com/): Developer portal for Samsung platform, device, and SDK resources.
- [SmartThings Developers](https://developer.smartthings.com/): APIs, tools, and documentation for SmartThings integrations.
- [Samsung Knox Developers](https://docs.samsungknox.com/): Technical documentation for Samsung Knox development and administration.
- [Tizen Developers](https://developer.tizen.org/): Resources for building applications on the Tizen platform.
- [Samsung Design](https://design.samsung.com/): Samsung design principles, stories, and design-related resources.
